name: site-clone-parity
description: Deterministic release gate for website clones: freeze references from a source site, gate a candidate rebuild on pixels, computed styles, hidden states, links, and breakpoints with the clone-parity CLI. Triggers on: clone a site, site clone, rebuild an existing site, pixel parity, visual parity, visual regression against a reference site, clone-parity, certify the clone, does my rebuild match the original.
